title: Verify and document object-aggrid plugin implementation
body:
The `@object-ui/plugin-aggrid` package already exists with complete AG Grid Community integration. Verified implementation, dependencies, and functionality.

## Status

**No changes required** - plugin is production-ready with:

- Lazy loading architecture (0.19 KB initial bundle, ~300 KB on-demand)
- 4 themes: Quartz, Alpine, Balham, Material
- Enterprise features: inline editing, CSV export, status bar, context menus
- Full TypeScript support with exported types
- 11+ interactive documentation examples
- 8/8 unit tests passing

## Implementation

The plugin follows ObjectUI's standard architecture:

```typescript
// Auto-registers on import
import '@object-ui/plugin-aggrid';

const schema = {
  type: 'aggrid',
  rowData: [
    { make: 'Tesla', model: 'Model Y', price: 64950 },
    { make: 'Ford', model: 'F-Series', price: 33850 },
  ],
  columnDefs: [
    { field: 'make', headerName: 'Make', sortable: true, filter: true },
    { field: 'model', headerName: 'Model', sortable: true, filter: true },
    { field: 'price', headerName: 'Price', sortable: true, filter: 'number' }
  ],
  pagination: true,
  theme: 'quartz'
};
```

## Integration

- ComponentRegistry: Registered as `type: 'aggrid'`
- Documentation: `/docs/plugins/plugin-aggrid` with live examples
- Dependencies: ag-grid-community ^32.0.0, ag-grid-react ^32.0.0 (peer deps)

![Plugin Documentation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/132b3c1e-0f4c-4e6b-b8f7-cb36b62341be)

## Build Output

```
dist/index.js         0.19 kB   ESM entry
dist/index.umd.cjs   15.00 kB   UMD bundle
dist/index.css      318.68 kB   AG Grid themes
dist/AgGridImpl.js    5.21 kB   Lazy-loaded implementation
```
